options.label: Best available
options.description: No constraint. This is the highest-scoring itinerary the solver could find anywhere in the network.

options.label: Commit to the West End
options.description: Every trail in the West End must be finished. The rest of the route is then optimized around that commitment.

options.label: Skip the West End
options.description: The West End is off the table entirely — no trail in it may be walked. The route is optimized over what remains.

options.label: Adaptive
options.description: Scores earlier and shortens cleanly. Gives up a little of the best available total in exchange for banking trail points sooner and leaving a menu of cuts you can take mid-race, each priced in advance.
